description: Convert a Stripe balance export (balance history CSV or itemized balance / payout reconciliation report) into a DATEV EXTF v700 Buchungsstapel. Every balance transaction is booked on the Stripe account: charges and refunds against a counter account, every Stripe fee as its own booking against Nebenkosten des Geldverkehrs, payouts against Geldtransit. Other currencies and duplicate rows are left out and counted. Returns the bookings as JSON, the EXTF file as base64 (Windows-1252) and a check of every payout against its transactions. Up to 500 transactions per call. Deterministic, 0 AI, nothing stored. Free: 5 calls/day per IP. Paid: Radar API key (from €15/mo at https://radarbg.com/pricing#starter via X-API-Key) or $0.005/call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/stripe-to-datev.

clientNo.description: DATEV Mandantennummer for the file header (optional)

consultantNo.description: DATEV Beraternummer for the file header (optional)

counterAccount.description: Counter account of charges, refunds and disputes (default 1360 / 1460)

csv.description: The Stripe balance export as CSV text (empty = built-in sample export)

feeAccount.description: Account of the Stripe fees (default 4970 SKR03 / 6855 SKR04)

fileContent.description: Or the CSV file base64-encoded (UTF-8 or Windows-1252, max 10 MB)

payoutAccount.description: Counter account of the payouts to the bank (default Geldtransit 1360 / 1460)

stripeAccount.description: Account of the Stripe balance (default 1362 SKR03 / 1462 SKR04)

name: stripe_to_datev
title: Stripe CSV to DATEV API - EXTF Buchungsstapel (SKR03 / SKR04) with fee and payout bookings
